Package org.example

Class Game<T extends View>

java.lang.Object
org.example.Game<T>
Type Parameters:
T - type of the view object that should be used for IO. Object must belong to a subclass of View and support its abstract methods.
public class Game<T extends View> extends Object
This class contains all game logic: dealing cards, checking Black Jacks, playing, checking victory conditions and displaying game state in view.
